Skim. Survive. Keep moving.

In Skimmies, you're not just skimming a rock across a pond — you're sending a stone on a journey across dangerous rivers filled with obstacles, creatures, and unexpected challenges.

Maintain your momentum, avoid hazards, and use unique stone abilities to overcome whatever each river throws at you. Navigate unpredictable waters, dodge dangerous creatures, and keep your stone moving as you race toward the finish line.

Two ways to play:

  • World Tour — Journey across the river through stages that bring new challenges, obstacles, and encounters at every turn.

  • Endless Mode — Test your limits. How far can you go?

Grow your run:

Unlock new stones, discover powerful runes, and find new ways to push further with every skim.

The river is unpredictable. Every skim is a new adventure.

Features:

  • Lots of stones to unlock

  • Lots of runes to discover

  • Boss fights

  • 8 unique biomes

  • World Tour mode

  • Endless Mode

  • Day and night cycles

  • Stone upgrading

Demo includes:

  • 2 playable stones (second stone unlocks after defeating the boss)

  • Learn the ropes Tutorial

  • World Tour mode which offers 1 biome with 6 levels (includes boss battle)

  • Endless mode (unlocked after world tour mode completion)

  • Achievement system

Skylane is an airline tycoon where you never touch the plane's controls. You do the job that actually decides whether an airline lives: which city pairs to serve, how often, with which aircraft, and who is qualified to crew them.

Start with one hub and one aircraft. Draw a route, lay flights across the week, hire a captain and a first officer rated on the type, and wait for the first load factor to come back. Then you scale operations, but all while fuel prices move, airframes age, and rival carriers expand into the markets you were saving for later.

Every screen is one keystroke away and the clock stops whenever you want it to. The question is never whether you can see the whole airline at once. It is whether you can still explain, after 10 years running your company, why every aircraft is exactly where it is supposed to be.

ONE ROUTE IS A DECISION. TWO HUNDRED IS AN AIRLINE


  • Open a route anywhere your aircraft can reach, and live with the range and payload it costs you
  • Routes mature. Demand builds over weeks, so a thin first month is not always a failure
  • Track load factor, weekly revenue and weekly profit per leg, and cut the ones that never turn
  • Every market you enter, you enter against a carrier already flying it

EVERY AIRCRAFT HAS ITS CALENDAR


  • Drag flights onto a seven-day calendar grid: add, duplicate, and mind the turnaround of our routes
  • Each airframe carries its own hours, cycles, condition and utilisation
  • Plan A, B, C and D checks yourself, or lose an aircraft to maintenance in the worst possible week
  • Ferry aircraft between bases when the network shifts underneath them

NO CREW, NO FLIGHT


  • Hire captains, first officers, cabin chiefs and flight attendants, base by base
  • Cockpit crew are type-rated. A pilot who cannot fly the aircraft is payroll, not capacity
  • Cabin crew work any type, which makes them the flexibility in your roster
  • Under-staff a base and flights cancel, on-time performance slides, and reputation follows it down

THE MARKET DOES NOT WAIT


  • Budget, legacy and aggressive AI airlines keep expanding while you deliberate
  • The market board ranks every carrier by fleet, network and profitability, including yours
  • Fuel price moves week to week. Build depots at your airports and buy when it is low
  • Payroll, maintenance and financing run whether an aircraft flies or not

BUILT FOR THE OPS DESK


  • Every screen is one keystroke away, with no menus hiding the number you need
  • Pause whenever you like, then run the clock at different speeds
  • Dense and monospace by design, built to be read at a glance rather than admired
  • A campaign week takes about twenty minutes, so a lunch break can be a productive session
  • Steam Achievements, Cloud saves, and original soundtrack

BUILD YOUR AIRLINE

Start with a small fleet and turn it into a global carrier. Choose where to fly, build your network around real passenger demand, and grow your airline in a world shared with competing carriers.

PLAN THE NETWORK

Every route is a business decision. Study local and connecting demand, set schedules and fares, secure airport slots, and decide where your aircraft can make the biggest impact.

OPERATE EVERY AIRCRAFT

Your fleet is more than a number. Schedule individual aircraft, build rotations, configure cabins, plan around turnaround times, and keep a growing operation moving every day.

RUN THE COMPANY

Acquire and negotiate for new aircraft, hire and develop your workforce, manage finances, build your brand through commercial partnerships, and make the decisions that shape your airline.

Skyline Sim combines detailed airline operations with the freedom to build the carrier you want. Start with one aircraft. Build something bigger.

Skyreap is a cozy base-building and automation game set on a world that broke apart into floating islands. You start by hand, chopping wood, digging ore, and hauling it all yourself, and slowly grow into production chains, warehouses, and airship routes that keep a dozen islands humming along without you, fully automated.

COLLECT RESOURCES

Gather raw materials and refine them.

EXPLORE

Send airships into the fog to find new islands and the ores you are missing.

AUTOMATE

Hire golems, link your buildings so they pass resources along, and connect the islands with standing supply routes.

THE DEAD ARE RAINING FROM THE SKY

Defend a neon cyberpunk district as infected rain from a breached corporate lab. Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain is a fast first-person action roguelike where survival means more than keeping yourself alive.

Intercept falling threats, protect humans, and strengthen your defenses through 15 escalating waves, culminating in a confrontation with the Scraper.

BUILD YOUR DEFENDER

All four Defender classes are available from the start. Choose the weapon and fighting style that suit your approach:

  • Skyguard: Control the airspace with a stable, long-range rifle.

  • Breacher: Crush close-range ground threats with a powerful shotgun.

  • Deadeye: Line up precise hand cannon shots and pierce through infected.

  • Ronin: Wield a cyber-katana for close-range combat.

Start with normal attacks and Focus. Spend Upgrade Tokens between waves or floors to learn and rank up active skills, passives and masteries, or install stat-boosting augments. Mix skills within your class and select the active attack you want to use. Coins buy supplies, equipment and district systems. Skills lists your abilities, Inventory your gear, and Stats their combined effects.

Combine Level-Up cards and System Shop upgrades between waves to shape your build.

Rare Recovered Tech grants a free upgrade for the current run.

PROTECT THE RESCUE GRID

Your four rescue drones move the Rescue Grid automatically to catch falling humans. Collect the Coins earned from rescues and spend them in the System Shop on equipment, rescue drones, and district repairs.

Defeated infected drop Bio-Samples. Collect enough to fill your XP bar and level up. Each level-up earns one Upgrade Token to spend on Level-Up upgrades between waves. Later levels need more samples. Your level, currencies, and upgrades last for the current run.

NEW: TAKE THE FIGHT INSIDE

Infiltrate Explore dark floors inside the Scraper with limited ammunition. On regular floors, find the exit elevator and choose when to extract. Meet the minimum required eliminations to leave without district damage, even if infected remain. Extracting earlier puts the district at risk. Stay for Coins and Elowen's keepsakes, but random encounters can drain your remaining health and ammunition.

Between floors, spend Coins on supplies and Upgrade Tokens on upgrades. Elowen cures ailments in the service bay and rewards returned keepsakes with rare upgrades. On the final floor, destroy the shield reactors, expose the Scraper Core and defeat it to unlock the exit.

Explore six floors with all four Defender classes.

BEND TIME. RETURN FIRE

Activate Focus to slow time; choose Toggle or Hold in settings. After learning an active skill, attack during Focus to use your selected skill. Special attacks spend extra Focus in addition to its steady drain. Dash to reposition and parry hostile projectiles with your attacks.

SURVIVE THE SHIFT

Face increasingly dangerous infected, including later-wave Brutes and Jumpers. Prioritize targets and protect the grid: infected that land in it become Overcharged. Certain enemy projectiles can Overcharge them too.

MAKE YOUR CALLSIGN KNOWN

Compare your performance on global leaderboards and follow worldwide Defender statistics.

Enable optional Online Records to publish completed-run scores, achievement unlocks, and anonymous Defender death reports. Your local progression and in-game achievements remain available with online publishing turned off.

Unlockable Hard mode

SKYSUNDER is an auto-battler fought on floating isles left over from the cataclysm. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics and unique unit modifiers called imprints, strategize each battle by giving every squadron its orders, then intervene in the course of battle yourself with 11+ spells!

GAMEMODES

  • Ascension mode - a single-player survival. 15 rounds of increasingly difficult randomized enemies before going endless and lasting as long as possible. Post your best high score!

  • FULL-RELEASE Multiplayer mode - face up to 7 friends in a private host multiplayer lobby. Grab your friends and test your skills in the free multiplayer demo.

  • UPCOMING FULL-RELEASE: Skirmish mode - practice for multiplayer by facing 7 opponents in a head-to-head battle! Each opponent has unique strategies and preferences.

  • UPCOMING FULL-RELEASE: Matchmaking - ranked system with a match-finder for battles of 8 players!

FEATURES

  • 64 unique units across 8 races - Human, Goblin, Elf, Troll, Dwarf, Ogre, Mystic, and Animal. These units are further divided into 6 combat classes and 4 tiers of rarity.

  • In-depth combat triangle - strategic ways to counter every playstyle.

  • Unique imprint system - every unit you see in the shop differs from the next with a system that encourages you to hunt for the best possible setup. Settle for CLUMSY units who perform poorly, search for ELITE or HEROIC troops that can single-handedly change the battle, or find the rarest EMPEROR trait that boosts the stats of all units sharing its own race.

  • 11 spells each with 3 tiers of power - change the course of battle by casting real-time spells from a BLACKHOLE that sucks units into the center, a MIRROR IMAGE spell to clone your Burrow and summon even more units, to a PLUNDER that blasts units and grants you gold for every kill you secure with it.

  • Upgrade your units with items and enchantments - each squadron in your army can be gifted up to three powerful upgrades to their equipment and 1 of 5 unique enchantments!

  • Build your town - 10 buildings make up your town, with each offering unique bonuses that shape your strategy. Will you be greedy and hyper-scale your economy, or will you take a careful balanced approach and invest heavily into your army and spells?

  • 60+ relics - relics are obtained every 3rd round, and have game-changing effects to shape your strategy. Combine relics for powerful effects and shoot for the perfect setup!

The hero fights on his own — and slacks off on his own

Inside a small window parked in the corner of your desktop, your hero fights automatically (and reluctantly). All you have to do is watch. There is just one problem: he is lazy.

When his motivation runs out, he climbs out of the battle screen and starts slacking off on your desktop.
He sits on the windows you have open, wanders along your taskbar, and falls asleep right there.
He will not get in the way of your work — but the game will not get anywhere either.

A by-the-book RPG

Underneath all of that, this is a properly traditional RPG.
You get classic turn-based RPG battles, exactly the way you remember them.
Fight, Run, Magic, Defend — put the commands to work and climb the tower. There are herbs, too, naturally.
You can buy gear, and you will find some along the way. Just remember that weapons and armor do nothing at all until you actually equip them.

The hero's party is a party of three, and you are free to build it however you like. That is the classic way, after all.

Step in now and then and things go a little smoother

There are no clicking contests here and no daily chores. Play it as a normal RPG, or just leave it running. Still, when your hero is off slacking, you should probably go collect him once in a while. He is supposed to be the hero, after all.

Even his slacking gets you a little something.

  • Sleep: HP and motivation come back, and he sometimes returns with a buff.

  • Scavenge: He forgets the battle entirely and wanders your desktop. He might come back with pocket change or a consumable.

  • Get hauled back by a party member: The hero returns to battle on his own, but expect some unnecessary chatter on the way.

Retreat and get stronger!

Aim for the 100th floor of the Demon Tower. In this world, thanks to assorted blessings, heroes simply do not die. They do not die — but the enemies keep getting stronger. Once you cannot climb any higher, retreat and head back to the tavern in town. The princess may get cross about it, but going home pays.
Spend the mana you earned in battle to power your hero up, then go for the 100th floor again. Collect enough abilities and the adventure keeps getting easier.

Rescue the princess with some dependable companions

  • A cleric who lectures, a mage with no MP discipline, a thief who opens chests uninvited. Adventure with the party members every RPG has.

  • Boots of Running Away, a Legendary-ish Sword, a Cursed Helmet that is not actually cursed. Plenty of gear whose descriptions you should not trust.

  • A weapon shop licensed by the Demon Army, an inn with a branch on every floor, a treasure chest parked somewhere suspiciously convenient. All the classics.

A game that stays resident on your desktop

  • You can enjoy this game while you get on with your work on the same PC.

  • When things get dicey, tuck it into the system tray. Show/hide and mute are there to help, too.

  • Please do not play it while you are on the clock.

  • While you are studying, though — that is probably fine.

Slacker Squad is a lightweight desktop idle game made to keep you company while you work.

When you start slacking off in real life, your squad members slow down too. But once you start hammering away at the keyboard and flinging your mouse around, they can feel the effort—

Time to go full speed!

You Slack Off, They Slack Off

The game dynamically calculates your squad’s work efficiency based on your keyboard and mouse activity.

When you work hard, they work hard.

When you start slacking, they immediately get the message.

The game only tracks keyboard and mouse activity frequency. It does not record what you type or click.

Tired of Working? Go Play Some Slacking-Off Minigames

Take a break from work and see what your squad brought back today.

Scratch-and-Reveal Wood Appraisal

Grab a scraper and slowly peel back the surface of a piece of wood.

Is it ordinary timber, or an extremely rare find?

You won’t know until you scrape it open.

Smash-and-Reveal Ore Appraisal

Grab a small pickaxe and start hammering away.

A plain-looking rock might be hiding a rare gemstone inside.

Work may not always come with surprises.

Rocks do.

I Can Rest. You Can’t.

Squad members lose stamina while working.

Running low?

No problem. You can roast some meat for them yourself.

Finished eating?

Good. Back to work.

That’s the whole idea:

You do the labor. I watch you do the labor.

Unlock More Slacker Squad Members

There are multiple characters to unlock.

Different squad members will work, slack off, gather resources, and react in their own way to whatever ridiculous orders the boss throws at them.

Can’t Beat Them? Bring Them Home.

Your squad may run into all kinds of monsters while out working.

Defeat them and you’ll have a chance to capture them as pets, letting them follow your squad members around.

Collect more pets over time and turn your small group of workers into an increasingly strange little workplace crew.

You Work, They Work

You don’t need to stare at the game all day.

Leave it running on your desktop.

Write code, make spreadsheets, argue with your boss—do whatever you normally do.

Then glance down every now and then.

Maybe someone is working at full speed.

Maybe someone has already started slacking off with the boss.

You work, they work.

You slack off, they slack off.

Slightly Used Sorcery is a cozy shop-management and crafting sim about running a little second-hand magic shop in a low-poly 3D town, where every curse has a customer.

Run Your Magic Shop

Arrange your shop, stock the shelves, restock from the daily Supplier, and serve a parade of eccentric visitors. Customers browse your displays, bring used artifacts to sell, haggle over every coin, and value enchantments according to their own peculiar tastes.

Influence Magical Chaos

Choose an artifact base, mix different Magic Dusts and target the enchantments you want. Your materials, equipment, skills, and workshop upgrades influence the outcome, but magic rarely behaves. A failed experiment might become worthless junk, a valuable discovery, or an unexpectedly brilliant mistake.

Turn Trash Into Treasure

Disenchant unwanted artifacts to recover materials and discover unknown enchantments. Craft new creations, complete special orders, or save unusual pieces for customers who appreciate their particular defects.

Equip Magical Oddities

Equip identified artifacts to turn their enchantments into passive effects that shape your crafting, research, haggling, customer attraction, and more.

Unleash Strange Synergies

Discover compatible pairs of enchantments, equip artifacts that carry them, and trigger their timed effects once a day at the right moment.

Choose Your Specialty

Begin each game as an Antiquarian, Haggler, Dust Savant, Steady Hands, Experimentalist, or Goose Meister, each with permanent strengths that support a different playstyle.

Build Your Collection

Record discovered enchantments and synergies in your Archive. Display your finest magical oddities in the Museum, increase your shop's Prestige, unlock new skills, improve your workstations, and expand your cluttered little business.

Key Features

  • Run and arrange your own magic shop
  • Buy, study, haggle over, and sell second-hand artifacts
  • Restock from a daily Supplier and gamble on mystery offers
  • Discover absurd enchantments through study, crafting, and disenchanting
  • Influence chance-based crafting with Magic Dust combinations, skills, and upgrades
  • Match strange artifacts with customers who value their unusual enchantments
  • Complete timed and wholesale orders for additional rewards
  • Collect funny enchantment combinations and uncover profitable synergies
  • Display your rarest curiosities in the Museum to raise your Prestige
  • Choose Easy, Balanced, or Hard difficulty for your shop
  • Deal with suspicious customers, questionable magic, and an unreasonable number of geese

Thousands of slimes march on your base, and each one is simulated individually, with its own weight and collisions. There's no path painted on the ground: the horde looks for the shortest route and squeezes through wherever it narrows. When it hits a wall, it piles up, slimes climb on top of each other, and if the wall is low, the mass pours right over it.


And they're not all the same. The small ones are fast, the big ones split into smaller slimes when they die, and the armored ones have a shell that has to break before any damage reaches the body. Every wave mixes these types differently, so the defense that held the last one might not hold the next. Every slime that dies drops gold on the ground, and that gold pays for whatever you build next.



Every level you gain during a run brings a choice between three cards. There are 40 in the deck, and they don't just raise numbers: they change the rules. Dead slimes that hurt whoever is stuck to them, shots that pierce the armored slime's shell, thrown bodies that hurt whatever they hit. Two runs rarely end with the same defense.


Losing is part of the game. What you earn in a run becomes essence, and essence opens the shop between attempts. It's a tree with eight branches, from walls to the deck, that unlocks new pieces like glue and oil, and gives your base more health, more money at the start and more card options. Every run starts a little stronger than the last.



Everything is built right on the map, block by block. Drag to draw a line of wall and pull up to stack floors. Towers go on top, where they see farther, or on the side, protecting the foot of the wall. When the pressure builds, swap wood for stone, then stone for iron. Put something in the wrong place? Sell it and get part of the money back, or undo your last move.


The horde behaves like water, and you decide where it flows. Every wall changes the route of every slime at once: close a passage and they go around, open a corridor and they rush through it. A good layout keeps the mass in the towers' sights for longer. But if you block the whole path, the horde stops going around and starts tearing down whatever is in front of it.


Eight attack and control pieces, each with its own way of dealing with the mass:

  • Cannon: an arcing bomb that bursts, digs into the ground and flies over walls, or a boulder that rolls along the ground.
  • Machine gun: a burst that shreds the line, or a precision shot that pierces armor from afar.
  • Tesla: lightning that jumps from slime to slime, or electrifies the ground the horde has crossed.
  • Ice: pins a few targets in place, or freezes everything around it in pulses.
  • Flame: a long jet that sweeps the line, or a furnace that roasts everything up close.
  • Glue and oil: puddles that stick, corrode, push the horde back or catch fire when it steps in.
  • Piston: a heavy shove that throws the mass back.

Each piece goes up to level III, and at the top you pick one of two forms. With the right cards, they combine: a frozen slime that catches fire explodes, lightning crosses a glue puddle without losing strength, and burning oil blows up whoever is next to it.



Nothing on the map is scenery. Walls feel the pressure of the mass, lose chunks until they give way, and the part that collapses crushes whoever is underneath. The towers on top don't vanish: they come crashing down too, right onto the horde. A tall wall holds more, but it falls from higher up.


The forest gets involved too. With enough slimes pushing, a tree topples over whole and the trunk lands in the middle of the mass. You can make trees part of your defense, just don't count on them forever.


And fire spreads. It burns the horde and jumps to the treetops around it. With oil on the ground, the horde lights the puddle itself as it walks through. Fire solves a lot of problems, as long as you know where it's going to stop.


Not even the ground stays the same. The terrain deforms and has physics. An explosion blasts open a crater, the horde slides in and only gets out when the slimes pile up into a ramp. Then the edge crumbles and the hole fills itself back in. A crater in the right spot becomes a trap.

Slime Mine Survivor is a roguelite action game where you mine 2D blocks and engage in Survivors-like combat.

Play as a slime, fight off relentless enemies that keep chasing you, and dig your own path deeper underground! Your weapons attack and your pickaxe mines automatically. Simple movement-based controls let you enjoy mining and combat at the same time!

But beware! The poison gas closes in from above on every floor! More ores, more treasure chests, more danger! Keep mining for bigger rewards or move on before the poison gas catches up with you. Time is running out, so choose wisely!

Evolve Your Equipment with Collected Ores! Your Evolution Choices Shape Your Playstyle!

Sell your mined ores to fund equipment upgrades or save them as materials for evolution. How you spend your limited resources will shape your build.

Both weapons and the pickaxe have multiple evolutions, each with its own attack and mining styles as well as special effects. There's no rush in the Intermission Area between floors! Take your time planning equipment evolutions and combinations to create your own powerful build.

Mining Meets Combat! Unleash Powerful Synergies to Smash Enemies and Blocks Alike!

Depending on your equipment combinations, attacks against enemies can also destroy blocks, while mining can trigger new attacks. Mining and combat go hand in hand, a big part of what makes this game fun!

One such mechanic is field effects, which cause blocks and floor tiles to become Burning or Freezing. Shatter frozen blocks one after another or set off chain explosions from burning blocks, opening up possibilities for mining and combat.

You can also get Artifacts in treasure chests, which grant various effects just by having them. Combine weapons, the pickaxe, and Artifacts to create powerful synergies. Feel the satisfaction of smashing through enemies and blocks alike!

Transform Your Slime with an Ore Blessing! Your Next Floor Depends on Your Choice!

In the Intermission Area between floors, you can choose an Ore Blessing to gain temporary boosts that last only for the next floor.

Receiving an Ore Blessing transforms your slime's appearance and enhances its abilities! It also increases the number of ore veins that appear on the next floor. Choose an Ore Blessing wisely to complement your build and push even deeper underground!

Videos & Livestreaming

Gameplay videos and livestreams are very welcome!

No prior permission or notification is required.

I'd appreciate it if you included the game title or a link to the Steam store page, but it's completely optional.

You are **Echo-1** — a recovered fragment of a lost intelligence, reactivated inside a simulation that is running out of time. Slingbox is a minimalist, physics-driven platformer built on one idea: **momentum is everything**. Dash, tether, and launch your way through the Protocol's abstract calibration layers, and don't stop moving until the clock does.

There are no enemies here. No hazards, no combat, no one to talk to. The only thing between you and the exit is the route you choose and how cleanly you can run it. Every layer teaches a single idea without a word — float, dash, tether, redirect, launch — then asks you to combine all of them under pressure.

[h2]Two layers. Two rulesets.[/h2]

**BOOT** (Layer 00) is clean zero gravity: no floor, no falling, nothing but conserved momentum and your own control. **CASCADE** (Layer 01) is where the simulation starts to fail. Gravity arrives. The palette decays from cold cyan to warm red. And the tether stops obeying its own rules — latching to an anchor now recharges your dash, a fault the Protocol insists is *"not correct."*

[h2]Precision, not punishment.[/h2]

Every level is 30–120 seconds of play, read one framed screen at a time. There are no fall deaths and no cheap shots: leave the play area and you simply resync at the start of the attempt — timer reset, instantly ready to run the line again. Failure costs you nothing but the clock.

[h2]Chase the clock.[/h2]

Every level carries four medals — Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Ghost. Bronze is finishing. Ghost is beating the developer's own best time. Best time and medal are saved per level, so the long game becomes the same run, again and again, getting closer to perfect.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]

[*]Tight, momentum-driven movement: an 8-directional fixed-distance dash and a springy rope that conserves velocity

[*]Twenty calibration levels across two worlds — clean zero gravity, then gravity and corruption

[*]One idea per level, taught without text, then combined under pressure

[*]Per-level Bronze / Silver / Gold / Ghost medals and saved personal bests

[*]Instant restart and a zero-punishment reboot — learn the route at speed

[*]A diegetic signal aesthetic: cold vector displays, phosphor bloom, and a simulation that visibly glitches as it decays

[*]Full keyboard and gamepad support, with screen-absolute movement that never fights your inputs

[*]100% procedural, royalty-free sound

[/list]

[h2]The signal is the story.[/h2]

There is no narrator and no dialogue — only the Protocol, a dying system that reports on its own failure through terminal logs and tearing frames. You are the anomaly inside it. Its integrity falls from 100% to 30% as you descend, and it remembers every surface you touch.

Slingbox asks one question and refuses to answer it: **why was Echo-1 made?**

Fast to start. Hard to perfect. Beat the clock.

FEED THE HUT

Slop Slop is a 1–8 player cooperative survival game. Venture into a procedurally generated swamp, scavenge the food demanded by a mysterious hut, and make it back alive before the night ends.

SEARCH THE SWAMP

Every run generates a new route through flooded ruins and treacherous bogs. Scour the swamp and its outer edges for food, strange equipment, shortcuts, and hidden mysteries.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Use the daylight to push deep into the mire. When night falls, enemies grow stronger and the journey home turns deadly. Unlock shortcuts from the far side and follow the glow of the great lantern tree to find your way back.

Anyone still outside when the night ends will die.

SURVIVE TOGETHER (OR DIE ALONE)

  • 1–8 Player Co-op: Brave the swamp solo or host a full crew of up to eight players.

  • Strange Equipment: Carry and operate bizarre tools with your team, revive fallen friends, and weigh the risk of pushing deeper versus heading home.

  • Proximity Voice Chat: Your voice only carries to nearby players. Stay close—if the group gets separated in the dark, your friends won't hear you scream.

  • Escalating Demands: Each new day brings a hungrier hut, deadlier creatures, and deeper secrets waiting in the swamp.

Slot Crawler is a top-down action roguelike built around a simple arrangement: the dungeon tries to kill you, bosses guard the tokens, and the machine decides what becomes possible next.

Fight through hostile regions, collect relics and abilities, assemble increasingly unreasonable builds, and bring your earnings back to the real star of the show.

Defeat bosses, collect tokens, and feed them to the slot machine.

Each unlock permanently adds a new relic or ability to the pool of rewards that can appear during later runs. Every result is new. No duplicates, no consolation prizes, and absolutely no refunds.

Need help with the next run? If you have tokens to spare, the machine can also help shape your starting loadout.

Even after every permanent reward has been found, it remains useful by doing what it does best: convincing you that the next spin will solve everything.

Everything the machine accepts is earned through gameplay. No real-money spins. It takes only persistence, questionable judgment, and the occasional heroic sacrifice.

Relics and abilities stack, evolve, and interact until a sensible strategy becomes a public safety concern.

Upgrade your abilities, fill the battlefield with projectiles, become suspiciously difficult to kill, or assemble something that makes you wonder whether anyone tested it.

Some relics make you stronger. Some change the rules. Some should probably have come with a warning label.

There is no single perfect answer. Only the setup that keeps you alive long enough to become a balancing problem.

Choose from a roster of heroes, each with a native ability, distinct attributes, and their own approach to survival.

Some rely on steel. Others prefer magic, poison, arrows, holy power, or music loud enough to qualify as blunt-force trauma.

Unlock new heroes, learn their strengths, and discover entirely different ways to use the relics and abilities you have collected.

A different hero can turn the same discovery into a completely different problem.

Every run rearranges rooms, encounters, shops, rewards, enemies, and opportunities to improvise.

Travel through distinct biomes, each with its own enemies, dangerous elites, environmental threats, and boss.

Learn their patterns, adapt your setup, and die a little wiser when things go wrong.

Master your luck or be consumed by it! Slotbound is a solo-developed roguelite defense game that fuses explosive 3x3 slot machine jackpots with deep autobattler strategy. Pull the lever to summon units, trigger massive synergies, and crush endless waves of enemies. It's time to put your luck and intellect to the ultimate test!

Pull the Lever! Say Goodbye to Ordinary Defense Games!

Tired of the same old tower defense? We've injected pure dopamine into the very core of combat preparation. Spin the 3x3 slot machine, match the lines, and summon your units. Feeling unlucky? Don't panic. There's nothing quite like the thrill of a single, desperate spin triggering a massive jackpot, filling the screen and summoning a legendary Prism unit to save the day.


Absorb, Evolve, and Reign Supreme

There's no such thing as a useless unit on this battlefield. Weaker units are sacrificed to feed the strong, becoming their flesh and blood. Watch an ordinary 1 star Warrior ascend into a stronger unit. Your branching class choices will completely shift the tide of battle.


Infinite Synergies That Overpower Pure Luck

This isn't just a mindless slot machine where you leave everything to chance. Every time a unit spawns, it rolls from dozens of 'Random Stats'. Combine these with unique unit 'Imprints', powerful Items, and game-changing Cores.

Trigger explosive Core synergies through meticulous planning. Exploit system loopholes, bend RNG to your will, and become the master architect of your own victory.


Forge Your Own Destiny

Slotbound is being made by one solo developer, built around the thrill of turning luck into strategy. Will you play it safe, or risk your life for maximum profit? Are you ready? The gold is stacked. Now, it's time to pull the lever!

YOUR WEAPON IS A SLOT MACHINE

Slots & Skulls is a turn-based roguelite. Your weapon is a slot machine, and you build the pool of symbols it can land on. Blades, spells, poisons, thorns, gold engines. Stop the machine's wheels one at a time. Whatever luck hands you decides the fate of that turn.

IN CONTROL, BUT NOT QUITE

112 different symbols: common ones that drop easily from kills, and legendary ones that only bosses drop. Every symbol has its own effect. Some boost the symbol next to them, some spend your health, some damage the enemy, some pay you gold. A few call for quick-fingered skill checks.

After every fight the shop opens. Buy new symbols and power-ups, reroll the stock if you do not like it, lock a symbol you cannot afford yet so it survives into the next shop, or remove a symbol you have outgrown from the machine's pool to streamline your build. Sometimes removing a symbol is smarter than adding one. Before every decision, the chart in the shop shows exactly what a purchase does to your attack, defense, gold, pool size and kill speed.

Luck matters, but not everything is luck. Four active power-ups sit on the d-pad, ready whenever you want them. Up to eight passive power-ups make you readier for the hard fights.

MORE RISK, MORE REWARD ON EVERY LEVEL

Ten levels, five fights each, 33 different enemies drawn pixel by pixel. Every enemy calls for its own strategy. Physical attacks do nothing to armored enemies, but magic goes straight through. Archers can stun you and cost you your next turn. Ice mages can freeze one of your wheels. Burn damage keeps eating your health in real time as the fight goes on. Thieves lift gold from your purse mid fight. Sometimes you face more than one enemy in a single fight.

Clear a level and you move straight into the next one with everything you own. Replay a level you already beat on raised difficulty modes for more symbols, skulls or gems. The higher the difficulty, the more you earn, and the tougher the enemies.

DROP BOXES, PULL SYMBOLS, TRY NEW BUILDS

After every fight you have a chance to win a chest with symbols inside. Depending on the chest's quality it can hold common, rare or epic symbols, or gems you can use on upgrade attempts.

Every fight you win also pays skulls, and you keep them even when you die. Skulls are precious: spend them at the forge to upgrade symbols, on modifiers that stay active for the whole run and can change how you play from the ground up, on adopting a cat and activating its pact, or on abilities that each shape the game deeply and take it beyond a game of chance.

THE FORGE DOES NOT JOKE

At the forge you can raise a symbol from +0 to +10. When a symbol is upgraded, all of its stats grow. On the other hand, the higher its level, the lower the chance of reaching the next one. And the tensest part: if the upgrade fails, you lose the symbol completely, with no way back.

Since the forge is that merciless, there are a few exceptional items that make things easier for you: gems. A green gem slightly improves a symbol's upgrade chance. A blue gem stops a failure from destroying the symbol, it only drops it one level. A yellow gem is extremely rare and guarantees the upgrade.

You can smelt the spare symbols you do not need back into skulls.

CHANGE THE GAME WITH CATS AND ABILITIES

Before every run starts, you can bring a cat if you like. You adopt cats with skulls, and every cat comes with a pact that lasts the whole run: one advantage and one disadvantage. One of them, for example, pays you interest after every fight based on the gold you hold, but gives every enemy a chance to steal a little gold from you. The cat you picked before the run hangs around the fight stage doing its own thing and never leaves you alone.

Also before the run starts, you can pick an ability. Abilities are a single move you can use only once per fight. The last symbol landed wrong just as a critical was about to hit? Use an ability and spin that wheel once more. Or skip this turn and double the effect of every symbol that lands on the next one. Six different abilities in total change the game from top to bottom.

COME BACK STRONGER EVERY TIME WITH MODIFIERS

21 different modifiers can be activated with skulls: more health, more damage, a chance for one last move when you die, two more wheels on the slot machine, and plenty more waiting for you to discover.

PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Invite a friend from your Steam list and play 1v1. A match opens with a draft: you pick three symbols each, in turns, and a symbol one of you takes is closed to the other. Then the round begins. You both beat the same enemies on your own screens, buying symbols from the shop after every fight. This part plays much like a campaign level, with one difference: this time the boss is the friend you invited. After four fights you duel them. After the duels the anvil opens: raise your symbols and you go in stronger than your rival, but you can lose the symbol you bet on. First to the set number of rounds wins the match. If you would rather skip the enemies, pick DUEL ONLY mode.

AUTO MODE FOR IDLE LOVERS

Once a fight starts, your slot machine spins, the symbols that land attack on their own, the enemy hits back, and the cycle repeats until one side falls. Turn on Auto Mode and the reels stop themselves; you only step in when a symbol calls for a skill check. Auto 2X Mode makes everything 2x faster. Your real decisions happen between fights: which symbols to keep, how far to push them on the anvil (every attempt can burn them), which cats to adopt, and which modifiers to take.

For Endless Mode you can even enable Full Auto Mode, which lets you try your build's strength without any interaction.

Start with nothing and work your way up through a city full of opportunities, risks, and rewards.

Take on small delivery jobs transporting everyday goods such as groceries, electronics, and liquor. As you earn money and improve your equipment, more lucrative opportunities become available, including the transportation of weapons, drugs, chemicals, and other high-value cargo.

The more valuable the delivery, the greater the danger. Criminals may attempt to ambush you and steal your cargo, forcing you to defend yourself and complete the job under pressure.

Expand your carrying capacity by purchasing larger backpacks, allowing you to accept bigger and better-paying contracts. Buy firearms and other equipment to protect yourself when jobs become dangerous.

As your finances grow, purchase vehicles that unlock entirely new ways to earn money. Work as a taxi driver, transport passengers across the city, or haul large cargo shipments for higher rewards.

Eventually, you'll be able to purchase your own property. From your home computer, gain access to exclusive high-risk delivery contracts and a darknet marketplace where rare weapons can be purchased and delivered to secret drop locations.

Survival is about more than making money. Your character must eat, sleep, and manage hunger and energy while balancing increasingly demanding jobs.

FEATURES

• Open-world urban sandbox
• Delivery jobs ranging from everyday goods to high-risk contraband
• Dynamic enemy ambushes during dangerous deliveries
• Backpack and inventory progression system
• Firearms and combat system
• Vehicle ownership and driving
• Taxi and cargo hauling jobs
• Property ownership and home computer system
• Darknet weapon marketplace
• Hunger and energy mechanics
• Save and load system
• Multiple paths to earning money and progressing

Smawverse is a dark fantasy bullet heaven, a survivor-like roguelite where your weapons fight for you. You play a stray cat reforged in iron, carving through the undead wreck of a kingdom that fell to its own keeper. Built in Unreal Engine 5.

Pray to the Nine

Nine prophets once held the kingdom together. Now they meditate in stone. Kneel at their shrines and they loan you a fragment of the power that was once theirs.

  • Nine prophets, each a distinct element: fire, frost, plague, shadow, arcane, and more.

  • Choose blessings as you level mid-run. No two runs play the same.

  • Forty-plus blessings to discover across the Nine.

  • Stack them deep enough and one cat becomes a screen-clearing storm.

Survive the Unmade

The kingdom's own keeper raised its dead and struck the living from the page. What remains wants you gone.

  • The streets never repeat. The city is laid out differently every time you enter it.

  • Hordes that escalate with the Danger clock until the screen is a wall of enemies.

  • Eight weapons, each a completely different playstyle.

  • Bosses that end your run if you built wrong.

  • Permadeath. The blessings return when you fall. You rise again sharper.

Grow Between Runs

Death is not the end of progress. Everything you earn carries forward into the next descent, and the hideout is where you spend it: the last standing corner of a fallen street, every station working.

  • Prophet Skill Tree: a deep passive tree with a chapter for every prophet. Earn Prophet experience from the shrines you favor and spend Talent Scrolls from bosses on build-defining keystones.

  • The Testament: an end-game tree of its own. Run two prophets together and write a page that belongs to the pair, with spells neither prophet has alone.

  • Weapon Mastery: every weapon levels on its own the more you fight with it, unlocking support nodes and a signature keystone.

  • The Cipher Station: some loot drops with affixes you cannot read. Start deciphering and there is no backing out. You commit, then choose between the original roll and a hidden alternate. Whichever you keep comes out stronger.

  • Capes: unlock a wardrobe of prophet-themed cloaks by mastering each prophet. Some carry a small edge in battle.

  • A hideout that restores as you progress, plus a stash that carries between runs, objectives across four chapters, and the Stone of Legends: leaderboards across four difficulties.

The Story, For Those Who Want It

There was a kingdom called the Daughter of the Sea. Its strength was not armies. It was nine prophets, one sacred scripture called the Word, and a people who fed each other's cats. The man who kept the Word wanted the power it would never give him. So he took it, and he unmade the kingdom with it. The prophets had one failsafe left: a word that could never be written, and a stray cat to carry it. That cat is you.

One cat. Nine prophets. A stolen scripture and the thing that took it. Take back the Word.

Welcome to Paradise City—sunny streets, lively hangouts, unforgettable women… and absolutely no guarantee that your opening line will work.

Smooch King is an anime-style idle dating sim about working on yourself, reading the room, and finding romance all over the city. Train your body, sharpen your mind, improve your social skills, and turn awkward introductions into something much more exciting.

Find your type—or several

The gym, library, cafeteria, park, mall, nightclub, university, cinema, and more are full of people to meet. More than fifty characters are waiting across Paradise City, each with her own personality, moods, dialogue, preferences, and relationship journey. Some are easy to find. Others expect a little more effort—or appear when you least expect them.

Build the hero you want to be

Activities earn Physical, Mental, and Social points over time, even while you are away. Spend them across twelve stats and create your own path through the game. Become charming, clever, athletic, persuasive—or somehow all of the above. Better stats reveal new encounters, unlock relationship milestones, and provide useful bonuses throughout the city.

Pay attention—it might be important

Talk, make dialogue choices, give gifts, and go on dates as relationships grow from Stranger to Soulmate. Moods have reasons, conversations contain clues, and every character has things she loves and things she would rather never receive again. A thoughtful gift can make her day. The wrong expensive gift may become memorable for entirely different reasons.

Work hard, flirt harder

Take jobs, earn money, attempt unpredictable special tasks, and discover surprise rewards while training. Spend your earnings at the mall, build a gift collection, complete goals and achievements, or take a break with minigames scattered around the city. There is always another way to improve your chances—or fund your next date.

Make some memories

Unlock dates, relationship moments, and collectible character poses as you grow closer. The Love Book keeps track of the people who have become more than strangers and lets you revisit the memories you earned together.

Paradise City keeps moving

Stay active and watch your progress grow, or leave an activity or job running and return later to collect offline gains. Play for a few minutes, settle in for a longer session, or simply check back when you are ready for your next move. Romance can wait—but it might send a notification.

Key Features

  • Explore ten anime-style locations across Paradise City.

  • Meet more than fifty characters, including secret encounters.

  • Develop twelve stats in the order you choose.

  • Navigate mood- and relationship-aware conversations.

  • Discover gift preferences instead of blindly spamming presents.

  • Unlock five date memories and collectible poses for each character.

  • Work jobs, attempt special tasks, and play varied minigames.

  • Keep progressing through optional offline activities and jobs.

  • Complete an onboarding journey, rotating goals, and achievements.

  • Play comfortably with mouse and keyboard.

---

SNAKE ECHOS

Your trail is your weapon.

Snake, but your own tail turns against you. Lay down a trail and a few seconds later it hardens into a wall — one that can kill you if you double back into it, but that you can also lure enemies into. Time your loops right and your own path becomes your best weapon; get greedy and it becomes the thing that ends your run.

Solo Mode

Kill enemies, gain XP, and level up. Each level-up offers three cards: two random picks from Magnet, Fireball, Scythe, or a stackable Aura/star-charge, plus Score Boost — always available, a guaranteed +5% score-per-level for players who'd rather cash in an ability slot for a higher score. Every 7th level swaps in a guaranteed 1UP instead, banking an extra life you can spend to survive a death. The board escalates as you level too: block formations start appearing, single blocks begin raining in, and eventually sweeping laser beams join the fight. Score, kills, and survival time all feed into a local leaderboard.

Duel Mode

Head-to-head score race against another player.

Three Difficulty Tiers

Calm, Flow, and Chaos — each with its own board size and pace, so you can dial in how frantic you want it.

Make It Yours

Upload your own music for the menu and in-game playlists, adjust volume, and toggle windowed/borderless display.

Classic Snake, rebuilt as a combat roguelite.

Eat. Grow. Then break every rule the old game taught you.

There is no tutorial. The Grid does not explain itself. It tests you.

You are trapped inside a living grid loop that wants to keep you in. Every run is a fight to escape before the Grid adapts, surrounds you, and pulls you back.

Grow longer. Get stronger. Then start cheating the system.

Turn your tail into a weapon: burn, shock, freeze, bite, devour.

Choose a snake class that twists the classic formula:

  • Phase through forbidden paths.

  • Chain speed.

  • Build around greed.

  • Survive with armor.

Master every class.

Pick, stack and evolve over 80 upgrades. Find strange powerups.

Take cursed mutations: power at a price.

12 enemy types hunt you. Hazards reshape your route.

Every sector changes the pressure: Frozen Loop, Burned Sector, Wild Code, The Core, Broken Grid.

Gatekeepers stand between you and escape. Break them, and the Gridmaster comes for you.

16 permanent upgrades. Every run makes you stronger.

Find shops, roulettes and secret rooms. Push deeper into the Grid.

Break out. Or fail.

The Loop wants you back.

Play the free demo now.

Snot Pop!

Save the Princess. Splat the Mould.

A single-screen, bubble-trapping arcade platformer in the spirit of Bubble Bobble and Snow Bros: descend into the slime-choked sewers beneath the goblin castle in Snot Pop!, a gloriously modern throwback to early ’90s arcade pixel platformers.

Descend into the slime-choked sewers beneath the goblin castle of Snotland in Snot Pop! — a glorious throwback to early ’90s arcade vertical pixel platformers.

The Goblin Princess has been snatched! The culprits? The Mouldlings: purple, sentient clumps of mould sporting legs, teeth, and absolutely dreadful manners. Step into the bare feet of an unassuming but utterly devoted goblin, armed with nothing but a loincloth, as you plunge into the subterranean labyrinth to rescue the goblin of your dreams.

Trap. Pop. Splat. Survive!

The basics are simple to pick up, but devilishly difficult to master. Blow snot bubbles to trap your foes, pop them to send the Mouldlings splatting against the dungeon walls. Hoard coins and gems, clear the level, and venture deeper into the muck.

Across fifty levels (and endless if you unlock freeplay), your greatest challenge is keeping pace. You will need to outmanoeuvre enemies, chain your bubble-pops for combos, and shave precious seconds off your runs to beat the clock and smash that high score.

Key Features:

  • Classic Arcade Action: Single-screen vertical platforming built for quick, dangerously moreish sessions.

  • Compete with the World: Steam Leaderboards for all-time scores, fastest victories and every level's time trial, on Easy, Normal and Hard modes, plus weekly boards and a new Level of the Week to master.

  • Gross-Out Charm: A wonderfully vulgar pixel-art rescue mission with a silly story that never takes itself seriously.

  • Endless Replayability: Procedurally generated platforms on a hand-tuned difficulty curve, with scripted enemy waves that test you fairly, then unlock Free Play for endless levels.

  • Play Anywhere: Full gamepad support, Steam Cloud saves that follow you between Windows, Mac and Steam Deck, and a game fully playable in English or Japanese.

   

Delving Deeper into the Sewers

  • 50 levels of procedurally generated platforms, then Free Play for as long as you last

  • Five enemy types: Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and the mighty Brute

  • Blow snot bubbles to trap Mouldlings, then pop them into oblivion and chain the pops for combos

  • Collect coins, gems and S.N.O.T. combos, and raid bonus rooms full of gems

  • Carved goblin idols and special coins grant temporary powers

  • Beat the clock: every level is a time trial, with your best times saved and ranked on Steam

  • 39 achievements covering bubbles, coins, score, clears, completion and speed

  • Optional story cutscenes following the Goblin Princess and the Mouldling invasion

  • Optional CRT mode for that extra retro feeling

  • Choose your screen frame from a selection of arcade cabinets

Built for quick runs, messy wins, and arcade-style play.

Snot Pop! is made for short sessions that turn into longer ones. Clear a few levels, chase a better time, unlock another achievement, and try again because you know you can do it faster, cleaner, and with a higher score.

The princess is still out there. The sewers are full of Mouldlings.

• EXPLORE WHAT'S BURIED BENEATH THE SNOW

    The house is only the beginning. Dig your way through the snow, discover new locations, and slowly uncover what happened to the buried town.

  • DON'T FREEZE — KEEP THE FIRE BURNING

    The cold won't wait. Search for fuel and keep the fire alive while you explore the snow-buried house.

  • UPGRADE YOUR SHOVEL AND UNLOCK NEW TOOLS

    Start with a simple shovel and gradually discover more powerful tools that open up new possibilities.

  • EXPLORE ABANDONED HOMES

    Behind every door could be a new path, a useful item, or another mystery waiting to be uncovered.

  • DON'T LET THE COLD WIN

    The deeper you explore, the more dangerous the cold becomes. Watch your temperature, find sources of warmth, and get back to the fire before it's too late.

  • ESCAPE THE SNOW-BURIED HOUSE

    Dig your own path through rooms and blocked passages. Sometimes the only way out is straight through the snow.

  • FIND THE UNEXPECTED

    There's much more buried beneath the snow than you might expect. Explore every corner, discover collectibles, uncover secrets, and find strange objects that are easy to miss.

  • USE DIFFERENT TOOLS

    A shovel is only the beginning. Discover new equipment, break through obstacles, and find ways into places you couldn't reach before.

  • DISCOVER WHAT HAPPENED OUTSIDE

    Escaping the house is only the beginning. What happened to the town — and what else is buried beneath the snow?

YOUR OWN FOOTBALL CLUB

The club develops through your decisions. Sign players, improve the squad, change the way the team plays, and push for promotion. Poor recruitment can hold the club back for years, while the right group of players can carry it far beyond expectations.

THE MATCHES

Matches can be viewed in a voxel-style 3D stadium or through a 2D match view. Watch the full 90 minutes and jump between highlights, or follow the action through several camera options.

Live commentary, player ratings, match statistics, lineups, and post-match reports show the full picture.

THE TEAM

Set formations, player roles, duties, mentality, and tactical style. Players can also be moved freely on the pitch when you want to build a custom shape.

Each player has more than 30 attributes: potential, traits, form, fitness, chemistry, and more, all of which affect how they perform and how effective they are over time.

Assign specialist coaches and use experienced mentors to teach new traits.

THE CLUB

Scouts can be sent to different regions or instructed to search for specific positions. Their quality affects what kind of players they can find.

Negotiate fees, wages, contract length, and release clauses before deciding whether a deal is worth the cost.

Sponsors provide objectives during the season. Stadium upgrades, training facilities, ticket prices, wages, and operating costs all influence the club’s finances.

Use the medical center to manage injuries, player fitness, and morale throughout the season.

THE LEGACY

Season records include top scorers, average ratings, league awards, and player achievements. Footballers improve, age, decline, and eventually retire, forcing the club to keep changing.

You have a boring job for corporate, everyone does. Even though it's soul-crushing work, it's easy enough and pays well, so whatever. To change now seems impossible... or is it?

When a mysterious voice calls from the sewer, take your chance to exit your mundane life and enter a world of camaraderie and chaos.

Something Really Evil Inc. is a real-time strategy roguelike about hacking an office. Delay the evilest of their projects, and get them cancelled by placing just the right hacks to distract workers, all while staying undetected by security.

The Crew

Four characters and their mysterious leader recruit you and aid you every week. Chat with them in your downtime and get to know them, and depend on them during the week to help you accomplish your goal.

Piper is the CEO's assistant secretly working against her. She gathers lots of important information for you, like what you can expect each day, and tracks the impact you are having on their progress.

Hank is the software expert, writing up the new hacks you will be using. The basic hacks are his tried and tested work, but you'll be thankful for his more advanced hacks as the week goes on.

Fluffypaw is a tinkerer, and loves making just about anything work. Each day, he prepares a few trinkets for you to choose from, each with a unique effect to make your job easier.

Gina bounces around, helping out everyone when they need it. For you, she has special "Challenge" hacks that won't be easy to deploy, but will grant the team great value when the day ends.

The Enemy

Yvonne is the real target. At first glance, she is just another CEO, but there are a few things uniquely odd about her situation. She has fans, the support of the government, everything. All while being heartless and business-cruel. It's confounding! However, her short temper will be her downfall. Just one project delay, one timeline miss, and she will crash out and blame anyone and everyone. If this happens enough, maybe the world will finally realize just how evil she and her company really are.

The Office

The office is full of electronic devices! The workers need them, but you do too! Place generator hacks to earn a currency called "KeyBits" that will be needed for all your hacking. Place distraction hacks to pop up memes on devices to stop workers from using them. Plenty of utility-type hacks exist that can benefit you, or hinder the workers in other ways. However, to keep security from catching on and shutting you out, use shroud hacks. Target the most productive workers, time your effects, and discover combinations and synergies to make the most of your limited space and resources!

Other Things

Something Really Evil Inc. offers a rich depth of gameplay, with many mechanics to combine and explore.

  • Tons of hacks, with tons of features! Hank wants you to try them all.

  • A crafting system, developed by Fluffypaw. Explore combinations and make stronger hacks!

  • Powerful bosses at the end of each week, each with unique support-type effects. Of course, the workers don't really appreciate their presence, but they sure will be more productive. Gina knows just how to mess with them!

  • If you get comfortable delaying simple projects, Piper can offer more challenging teams and projects to face down!

  • And so much more to discover!

Welcome to Something's Off — a chaotic, dimension-hopping celebration of glorious nonsense. A place where logic goes straight out the window, and the laws of physics are little more than a loose suggestion.

This is an asynchronous competitive game that blends the sneaky cunning of hide-and-seek with the sharp-eyed focus of a classic spot-the-difference puzzle.

You’ll take turns stepping into two roles: the Hider and the Seeker.

As the hider, you are a walking rule-breaker. Across sprawling, hand-crafted maps, your job is to tuck wildly out-of-place oddities perfectly into the scenery. Bury a stinking can of surströmming deep in a sickly-sweet candy wonderland; Float a drone hovering right above the heads of civilians in 10th-century Bianjing; Let a goofy, dozy pup nap on the silty seabed, blowing slow bubbles in the silent dark depths.

Your goal isn’t just to hide — it’s to hide things so absurdly, yet so seamlessly, that your opponents will kick themselves the second the answer clicks.

As the seeker, you are the defender of order. Bring every ounce of your observation skills to bear, and pick out the tiny, logic-defying clues hiding in plain sight. Is it just a trick of the light… or a telltale slip from the hider?

Something’s off. But what? Will a sharp eye carry the day, or will unhinged creativity reign supreme? It’s all up to you to find out.

It is a stormy night in the early 2000s. You have just moved into a new home, and something in the dark is waiting.

After settling in, your father finds a dusty box in the attic left behind by the previous owners. Inside: a 90s video game console, a heavy CRT monitor, and a stack of unmarked cartridges. He tells you to leave them alone until morning. You don't listen.

Driven by curiosity, you plug in the console in the middle of the night. What begins as a nostalgic stroll through low-poly, liminal 90s games quickly turns into something far more disturbing.

Each tape holds a sinister history. As you progress deeper into the cartridges, the line between the screen and your room begins to blur.

You aren't just playing these games—you are awakening the curse trapped inside them. To uncover the truth of what happened in this house, you must keep playing, while constantly monitoring your bedroom and hiding from the entities spilling out of the screen.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dual-Layer Survival: Balance retro game progression on your CRT monitor with real-time hiding and survival management in your bedroom.

  • Liminal PSX Aesthetics: Nostalgic 90s low-poly visuals, authentic CRT distortions, and unsettling atmospheric audio design.

  • Curse Escalation: Watch harmless-looking games gradually deteriorate into surreal, psychological nightmares.

  • High-Stakes Hide & Seek: Pay attention to the subtle cues around your room. When the curse manifests, find a place to hide before it's too late.

Turn a filthy, rubbish-strewn beach into a lively seaside destination. Clean, recycle, build and run your business as you watch the beach come back to life.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Clear the Rubbish, Reclaim the Beach

Unlock powerful tools, drive a loader to clear rubbish mountains, and put drones and autonomous cleaners to work. Recycle rubbish to fund better equipment and enjoy the satisfaction of turning a filthy beach spotless.

Build Your Beach, Grow Your Business

Sell tickets, welcome visitors, build leisure facilities and keep order on the beach. Upgrade your tent to a hut and build a rubbish transport network to make distant cleanups easier as your seaside business grows.

Follow the Tides, Explore Underwater

Catch crabs, dig for shellfish, spearfish and scrape off barnacles. Explore the shore and seabed, then stock your seafood stall with fresh catches and turn your seaside discoveries into income.

Uncover Treasures, Wash Away the Grime

Find treasures buried in the sand or floating at sea. Wash your finds to reveal their original appearance. Keep your favourites or put them up for sale to fund your next beach improvements.

Larithea is a cute anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding your way back from the darkness. A team of young mages is sent out into the world — each of them with their own road ahead. Others have walked it before. Few found their way back.

Build your spells

Craft your own spells from the materials you gather — combine sigils to make the attacks and support your team runs on.

Lead the team

Turn-based encounters on a grid. Place your spells, plan your positions, watch the fight unfold.

The world

Something is off at the edge of the desert. Strange lights, old spells waking up, water gone from where it always was. Ormron sits at the border of a Veil no one crosses — and whatever's stirring out there was buried a long time ago, on purpose.

Meet the team

  • Maya — silver-haired heiress to a healing dynasty and the largest private hospital in Ormron, Maya has never known want or hardship. Her future was settled the day she was born — and a schoolgirl crush on the school's most sought-after Magister was never going to change that, unless it did.
  • Tara — a girl with no past and no certain future, Tara has fought for everything she owns. All she wants is a place of her own in the world — even if earning it means joining a pack of privileged brats on a fool's errand.
  • Nell — quick to laugh and quicker to burn, Nell collects friends in minutes and grudges quicker still — it only takes someone cruel picking on someone smaller. Ask him about home and the smile stays; the answers stop.
  • Grey — born in a free city of the north, the idle son of a prosperous baker who paid his tuition in full, coin counted out on the table. So where does his knowledge of the old magic come from?
  • Dart — the most talented student in the school and the coldest, Dart earned a Magister's badge before most of his year earned a passing mark, then took every field assignment that led away from Ormron. About his life before the school he has never said a word.

In this chapter

  • A five-member party, each with their own school of magic
  • Spell crafting from sigils
  • Dozens of turn-based battles across a branching path through the Ormron desert
  • A story told in chapters, released one at a time

One person makes this

Larithea is a solo passion project, made in Sydney, released a chapter at a time. The heroes and their magic schools came from Серце гріє (The Heart Warms), a fantasy novel I wrote, published in 2008. The book told one version of that world. This is the one you play.

Your comic collection has been scattered all over the place. Time to sort it out!

Comics on the floor, piles everywhere, incomplete series, and shelves just waiting to regain some sense of order.

In SORT MY COMICS!, examine each comic, identify its series and format, then find the place where it belongs. Little by little, the chaos disappears, collections come together, and the room transforms before your eyes.

FROM ABSOLUTE CHAOS…

At first, all you have are your hands and your sense of organization. But the further you progress, the more comfortable sorting becomes.

Unlock and upgrade powers that can reveal comics from the same series, show you where they belong, pull them toward you, move them with telekinesis, or even let your drone handle part of the work.

…TO THE PERFECT COLLECTION.

There’s no pressure here. SORT MY COMICS! is a sorting and collecting game built around the simple pleasure of watching a huge mess gradually become perfectly organized.

Sort at your own pace. Complete your series. Upgrade your abilities.
And most importantly… find a place for all those comics!

Features:

  • Thousands of comics to sort across a huge collection.

  • Multiple formats and series to identify and organize correctly.

  • Upgradeable powers that make sorting increasingly fast and satisfying.

  • A drone that can help out while you take care of something else.

  • A collection that visibly transforms as you progress.

  • No timer: organize everything at your own pace.

  • The simple pleasure of going from “what a mess” to “there, now that’s perfect.”

A mountain of bunnies. A place for every one of them.

Sort the Bunnies is a cozy first-person organizing simulator. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op, turning a shop full of scattered toys into colorful collections.

Find a match in the pile, carry it to its shelf, and fill that last empty space. Bring matching bunnies together and watch a cluttered shop become a display worth admiring.



Share the shop with up to three friends in online co-op. Split up the sorting, help each other find missing bunnies, or take a break for a completely unnecessary toy fight.



Earn coins as you sort and spend them on a helping hand. Carry more, reach farther, reveal matching bunnies, and collect nearby matches into your basket.



Line up the claw, make your grab, and see what comes out. Take a break from the shelves to win temporary powers and playful accessories for your bunny.



Unlock the bunny-ear hoop and turn tidying into target practice. Land a bunny through the hoop and watch it fly to its shelf. A little aim goes a long way.



Use the pump to puff up a giant version of your favorite bunny. Keep pumping and watch it grow right in front of you. That should be big enough… probably.



Start a toy tower on a friend's head and see how ridiculous it can get. Between the sorting and the flying bunnies, there's always time for one more questionable idea.



Give your favorite bunny a moment in the spotlight. Watch its tiny family pop out of a hat and put on a show at the miniature theatre before you head back to the shelves.



Meet 500 bunny designs across 20 themed collections, from sweet treats and tiny tea cups to space explorers. With 5,000 toys to sort, there's plenty to find—and plenty of satisfying gaps to fill.

Soul Link - End and Rebirth is a premium offline turn-based RPG.

As an amnesiac commander, you lead soul companions shown as battle cards through twenty story chapters. Act I exposes the empire’s erosion conspiracy; Act II introduces memory fragments and asks whether your victories were already entered into a higher ledger—ending in one of three finales: Rebirth, Uproot, or Sync.

Highlights

• 200 main stages (Ch1–20) plus card-framed story scenes and chapter key art

• Growth: levels, stars, equipment affixes, and offline unlocks for limited companions

• Memory fragments as light passives (equip up to 3); progress-gated, not daily

• Post-game trial floors with condition modifiers; infinite farming, no stamina

• Progress chests on elite/boss/finale first clears—no daily login or energy walls

Not this game

• Live-service PvP, battle pass, or real-money gacha

• Full-body dating / Live2D romance routes (visual strategy is cards + key art)

Soul Tides is a dark-fantasy tug-of-war strategy game where players summon armies, build shrines, and push the battlefield toward their enemy’s stronghold.

Soul Tides brings the classic tug-of-war strategy formula into a modern standalone game.

Tug-of-War Combat – Deploy minions that fight automatically, pushing the frontlines toward your enemy’s stronghold in a relentless battle for control.

Build & Expand – Construct Shrines and fortifications to unlock powerful Blessings and units.

Customize Your Army – Research and assign unique abilities to your minions, creating devastating synergies.

Pray for Power – Unlock new units and abilities to dominate the battlefield.

Deep Tech Tree – Unlock new strategies with a dynamic research system that ensures no two matches play out the same.

Multiplayer Mayhem – Challenge friends and rivals in intense PvP battles, where strategy and adaptation are the keys to victory.

Resource Management – Balance Gold, Supply, and Souls to maintain an army capable of overwhelming your foes.

Dark Fantasy Atmosphere – Immerse yourself in a world of forbidden magic, demonic bargains, and relentless warfare.

Trials — Single Player Challenge Mode

Beyond the battlefield lies a path of Trials.

In this single-player challenge mode, you will face a series of encounters designed to test your mastery of strategy and adaptation. Each Trial presents new enemies, modifiers, and powerful guardians that stand between you and victory.

Choose your shrines, shape your army, and push the frontlines forward as you battle through a map of Trials. Defeat formidable bosses, experiment with different builds, and discover powerful combinations of units and Blessings.

Victory is only the beginning.

Every run is a chance to refine your strategy and prove your command of the battlefield.

Trials Feature Highlights

Epic Boss Encounters
Face powerful enemies that guard the path forward and demand new strategies to defeat.

Trial Map Progression
Advance through a network of encounters, each bringing new challenges and opportunities.

Endless Build Possibilities
Combine shrines and Blessings to create unique armies every run.

Score-Based Leaderboards
Compete for the fastest victories and highest scores.

Will you rise once more, or be cast into oblivion?

Wishlist Soul Tides now to be notified when the battle begins.

One little slime. More power with every round. Soul of Slime is a strategic auto battler where card choices, elemental synergies and resource management shape every fight. Make your decisions between battles, then watch your slime put them into action.


Buy cards from the shop, manage your gold and make every limited card slot count. Get stronger now or save for your next upgrade? Merge duplicate cards up to L3, unlock powerful abilities and assemble a build whose parts work together.


Granite, Mercury, Ember, Frost, Astral and Quintessence. Specialize in one element or mix several to create synergies. Your cards and their levels shape how your slime fights. Individual power matters, but so does the way your cards work together.


Once battle begins, attacks and card abilities activate automatically. Watch the outcome, spot weaknesses and prepare for the next round. Asynchronous PvP, planned for release, will pit you against real players’ saved builds without requiring your opponent to be online at the same time.


Start each run with 3 lives. Every lost battle costs a life; your goal is to complete 10 rounds before they run out. Keep adapting through new cards, upgrades and changing matchups.


After successfully completing 10 rounds, continue into Endless mode in the full game. Keep your build, gold and remaining lives as battles grow tougher. Carry on upgrading: there is no fixed final round, and your run lasts until your lives run out. Then start again with a different combination.
