The Soulbuster Corpo is hiring. The job interview is a cap-throwing trial.

SOULS CAPS is a roguelite deckbuilder played to the beat. Every throw has two beats: the measure, then the impact. Your rhythm decides how many caps fall. Your deck decides what they're worth.

A rhythm phrase opens every throw. Every note you hit charges your puck, every PERFECT pushes the multiplier up. Keep the combo going while the recruiter speeds up, slows down, and slips cursed caps into your stack.

Your puck slams into the stack. Caps flip over and their effects chain together: devourings, resurrections, vortexes, landslides, chains…

Before every first throw, you draw a hand of caps and choose where they go: on top of the stack or at the bottom. Arrange your stack to set up your combos.

Skeletons raise their dead: what has fallen falls again and scores again.

Imps devour whatever comes after them. What they burn will never score, but every meal makes them hungrier.

Golems crush one another and build up mass from throw to throw, until they unleash it all at once.

Arcane chains, multiplies, and reaches the bottom of the stack where the cascade never goes.

Every cap comes in four rarities: common, rare, holo and prismatic.

At MEGACAPS, spend your essences: cap boosters, marbles and pucks. Rip the booster open, keep what you want, grow your collection.

Thirteen pucks, each with its own rhythm pattern and marble slots: passive or active abilities that power up your throw. Save a marble for the right moment, then let it loose.

Difficulty isn't a slider, it's a contract. Sign clauses, build your contract, climb all eight rungs. Every clause pays a bonus that matches the risk.

Three worlds, fifteen stages, one life: twelve interviews, three of them against a Big Shot, and one Merchant per world. The job is waiting for you at the very top.

  • 420 caps to collect

  • 76 marbles, 13 pucks

  • 3 worlds, 15 stages, one life

  • 15 to 20-minute runs

Journey Into the Unknown

Souls Divided is a puzzle game about perception, duality, and control. You play as a Dreamer who enters the astral realm of Namuru, a mysterious world shaped by two opposing forces: Order and Chaos.

To progress, you must split your soul and control multiple forms at once.

One body. Two souls. Three realms.

Control a physical body anchored to two ethereal forms, one aligned with Order, the other with Chaos. Each form experiences the world differently:

  • Platforms may exist in one realm but not the other

  • Paths shift depending on your perspective

  • Obstacles can disappear or appear when you switch forms

Mastering these overlapping realities is the key to solving each puzzle.

Puzzle systems that evolve

As you progress, new mechanics are introduced and combined in increasingly complex ways:

  • Observers: Being seen forces your astral form back. Use line-of-sight to your advantage

  • Astral Platforms: Some objects on the realms interact with this platforms to open new paths

  • Astral Mirrors: A linked mirror pair that extend your gaze to another space. Anything seen through the mirrors change their state

  • Floating Crystals: Tools that change the state of objects can activate or deactivate this crystals. Change their state to control platforms and shift obstacles

  • Dual Wormholes: Push and pull objects across space

  • Limbo Dome: Shift objects between realms to solve layered puzzles

And much more... Each mechanic builds on the last, creating deeper and more challenging interactions.

Your tether is not a leash, it is a tool

Your forms are connected by a tether not just as a limitation, but as a core mechanic:

  • Pass the tether through objects to activate or alter them

  • Trigger mechanisms, open paths, and break barriers

  • Manage its position carefully some things sever the tether on contact

Understanding how to use the tether creatively is essential.

Key Features

  • Solve puzzles across three overlapping realms; Physical, Order, and Chaos

  • Control multiple forms with unique perspectives of the same space

  • Use a tether-based interaction system to manipulate the environment

  • Experiment with observation-based mechanics where being seen has consequences

  • Experience progressively complex puzzles that reward logic and precision

  • Explore a subtle, mysterious world inspired by original cosmology drawing from Gnostic philosophy and Zoroastrian dualism not good vs. evil, but the tension between structure and change

Soulstack is a card-stacking RPG where everything happens by dragging one card onto another. You wake up in an unknown world and slowly start to explore the game like your character explores the world.

 

Drop your hero on a tree for wood or on a rock for stone, and feed spare cards to the Soulstone for XP. Put two parts on the workbench and see what comes out: 300+ weapons, from a stone on a stick to a hand-held ballista.

 

Drop your hero on a dungeon and the fight plays out on its own. Your weapon, your class and your pet decide how it goes, floor after floor of randomized enemy factions.

 

Find a strange creature, name it and pick its evolution path: 140 forms in all.

 

At each level cap you awaken into a new class. There are 48, and 9 of them are cursed.

 

In the City, the enchanting table turns a +5 weapon into a named artifact. You need the right one to evolve your class further.

 

Take quests from the village, then leave the Wilds for the City and the Monster-Lands and face the final boss.

 

Then step through the portal into a reshuffled world. Every class and pet form you discover unlocks a legacy perk, and you pick which ones to start the next world with. Your researched recipes come with you too.

 

A free demo covers the first act, the Wilds.

My next game - Keep Making Games

Now that Soulstack is out, Keep Making Games is what I'm working on next.

Every Sheikh-sized fortune has to start somewhere. Yours starts with a tiny baqala in a 2002 Arabian Gulf city inspired by Old Dubai and Riyadh.

Run your baqala, build relationships with neighborhood regulars, chase thieves with your BB Gun, and expand your store as you build your fortune. Invest your Foloos in businesses around town and rise to the top. Solo or together in online co-op. Experience an old-school Arabian Gulf neighborhood inspired by Dubai and Riyadh before the glamour, and work your way up from humble shopkeeper to The Souq Boss.

👇الترجمة العربية الكاملة موجودة أدناه👇

EXPERIENCE THE ARABIAN GULF BEFORE THE GLAMOUR

Created by developers who grew up in the Gulf, the neighborhood is packed with the places, characters and details we remember. From shisha cafés and internet cafés to mosques, bakeries, construction sites and empty sand lots.

Welcome to the neighborhood. Your baqala is waiting.

RUN YOUR BAQALA

Order products, stock your shelves, set prices and serve customers as you try to turn a small neighborhood store into a growing business.

But running a baqala isn't always peaceful...
Keep an eye out for thieves — and grab your BB Gun when someone tries to make a run for it. 

GET TO KNOW THE NEIGHBORHOOD

Meet neighborhood regulars like Abu Khaled, learn what they want, complete their requests and build relationships with them.

Level up those relationships to unlock special items, new stores, skins and more. 

MAKE FOLOOS. SPEND FOLOOS. MAKE MORE FOLOOS.

Growing your store is only the beginning.

Expand your baqala and use your profits to invest in other businesses around town, including the local Shisha Cafe, creating new sources of income as you build your neighborhood business empire.

Become an adorable space squirrel and explore the vast reaches of space with your companions.

SPACE DARAM is an open-world survival game where you travel aboard your spaceship, explore new planets, gather resources, and build survival outposts and space bases.

Craft equipment, expand your ship, and create a place of your own across multiple planets. Set out on a new adventure through the vastness of space with your small but energetic companions!

🚀 Your Mobile Base, the Spaceship

Your spaceship is both a mobile base and a home where you and your companions live together.

Manage its power, expand its capabilities, and prepare for your next adventure!

But stay alert: mysterious enemies are tracking your ship's trail.

🌍 Unpredictable Planetary Exploration

Every planet features different terrain, climates, and hazards, offering a new kind of adventure each time.

Discover new resources, investigate unknown environments, and gradually expand the reaches of your exploration!

⚔️ Battles Across the Planets

Equip a variety of weapons and take on the combat robots you encounter while exploring the planets. Join forces with your companions, brave the dangers ahead, and venture into new regions!

🏠 Build Your Own Space Base

Install a Base Module and deploy its shield to lay the foundations of your base.

Place a variety of structures and production facilities to create a base that is truly your own.

With your companions helping out, your base will grow even faster!

🔋 From Power Generation to Crafting!

Spin the exercise wheel to generate power, then use that energy to keep production and crafting running.

Every little contribution helps your base operate faster and more efficiently!

👥 Small but Dependable Companions

Charming companions with tiny bodies and gently swaying tails will stay by your side.

They excel at exploration, combat, gathering, and production, working together as a team!

🤝 An Adventure to Enjoy Alone or Together

Set out alone to explore space at your own pace and take on the challenge of survival,

or team up with friends to expand your base and share the adventure in cooperative multiplayer.

One small mining ship. An endless galaxy. Your desktop.

Space Travelers is a relaxed 2D space mining and exploration sim. Start with a modest ship in a quiet corner of the galaxy, dig rare minerals out of asteroids and planets, trade at the station, and push your range outward sector by sector. The map never runs out: the universe grows with you.

You do not have to stop playing to get on with your day. Pin Space Travelers to your desktop as a live wallpaper: the simulation keeps flying behind your icons, mining, traveling and discovering while you work, and only asks for you when a real decision needs to be made.

What you will do

  • Mine and trade. Crack planet crusts with better drills, watch prices react to what you sell, deliver contracts, and when it suits you, deal on the black market.

  • Explore without end. Scanners, deep space signals and observatories keep revealing new worlds. The further you go, the richer and the more dangerous space becomes.

  • Build your network. Fuel tank outposts, refineries over gas giants, mining drones and observatories turn empty space into your own supply line.

  • Grow your fleet. Thirteen hull classes with their own module caps and range classes. Upgrade engines, drills, tanks, scanners and shields, and keep your ships in the hangar.

  • Survive the road. Meteor swarms, pirate signals, strange encounters: every trip can turn into a story, and the rescue service is never free.

  • Chase the signal. Something ancient is waiting out there, beyond the plasma frontier. Finding it changes what you know.

A game that lives on your desktop

  • Live wallpaper mode on Windows and macOS: the game plays on behind your desktop icons, on the monitor you choose.

  • Critical events appear as a small decision panel; everything else patiently waits for you.

  • Pin a compact route widget to your desktop and plan your hauls without opening the full window.

Good to know

  • Relaxed pace. No reflexes required; the game respects your attention.

  • Plays fully offline. Interface available in 15 languages.

  • Procedurally generated universe, with optional custom seeds for fresh starts.

Blast Your Way Through Space

Take control of your spaceship and fight your way through relentless waves of deadly meteors in a fast-paced arcade space shooter.

Dodge incoming threats, destroy massive meteor formations, and survive increasingly dangerous encounters as you push deeper into space. Every stage introduces new challenges, enemies, and threats that will test your reflexes and shooting skills.

Features

  • 20 challenging stages to conquer

  • Powerful bosses that put your skills to the test

  • Many different meteor types, each with unique abilities and threats

  • Multiple weapons to help you survive the chaos

  • Ship customization to personalize your spacecraft

  • Endless Mode for an escalating arcade survival challenge

  • Fast-paced 2D arcade gameplay focused on shooting, dodging, and survival

  • Retro-inspired space setting with a classic arcade feel

Can You Survive?

Destroy meteors, master your weapons, customize your ship, defeat powerful bosses, and push your limits in Endless Mode.

The further you go, the more dangerous space becomes.

Into the Ocean, Armed with a Spear

Carefully close the distance to your target, take aim, and launch your spear. Experience the tension of spearfishing from a first-person perspective and the satisfaction of returning to the surface with your catch in this freediving spearfishing simulator.

Study Fish Behavior

Different fish species have different behaviors. Some swim in schools, others defend territories around rocky reefs, while some hide in the sand or behind obstacles. Approach carelessly, and they may become wary and flee. Observe how they swim and where they live, then find the best approach for each species.

Adapt to Changing Ocean Conditions

Water temperature, turbidity, and wave conditions are constantly changing. The ocean environment varies from day to day, affecting visibility and diving conditions even at the same fishing ground. Manage your oxygen and body temperature carefully, and know when to turn back and return to the surface. Making the right decision is an essential part of spearfishing.

Choose the Right Equipment

Spears, spear tips, fins, wetsuits, and diving lights each have different characteristics. Whether you want to dive deeper, get closer to fish, or stay warm in colder waters, choose equipment that suits your fishing ground and target species. Develop your own spearfishing style.

Bring Home Your Catch and Explore New Waters

Sell the fish you catch or deliver them to fulfill requests. Use your earnings to purchase new equipment and fishing licenses, unlocking new fishing grounds along the way. Every fish you successfully bring back is recorded in your encyclopedia. Dive into different seas and discover fish species you've never encountered before.

Only one fishing ground is available in the demo version.

SpecterMancer is a 1–6 player multiplayer horror experience set in a dark Victorian era shaped by witchcraft, cults, and the supernatural. One player takes on the role of an invisible ghost, while the others are trapped as survivors inside a haunted location and must find a way to escape.




Become the Ghost

As the ghost, you can see the survivors while remaining completely invisible to them. Watch their every move and turn the environment into your own paranormal playground.
Manipulate objects, create apparitions, unleash terrifying visions, and set up unexpected scares to play with your friends’ nerves. You can also take control of horrifying creatures and send them after the survivors when you want to take the fear one step further.

Survive a Haunted Place

As a survivor, you never know where the ghost is or what it is preparing for you. Explore procedurally generated environments where every match changes the layout, the dangers, and the possible ways to escape. Search for clues, interact with the environment, and solve puzzles with your teammates as you try to make it out alive. Stay alert: apparitions, creatures, and paranormal events can strike at any moment. Survive at all costs.

You never know when the next scare will come.

Every room can hide an apparition, a creature, or a paranormal trap set by the ghost.

Build Your Own Railway Worlds

Create, customize, and bring your own maps to life with a powerful railway editor. Design unique track layouts with elevations, banked curves, crossings, junctions, and any combination you can imagine.

Place buildings for loading, unloading, stations, and other railway operations, then shape the world around them with decorations, nature, environments, structures, signs, and details that make every map feel alive.

Simple to Drive, Hard to Master

Driving the train is easy to understand, but mastering it is another story. As you move across the map, you will need to make quick decisions: switch tracks, control your speed, reverse when needed, and use the map view to plan the fastest route ahead.

Speed matters, but so does control. Your locomotive type, wagon count, cargo weight, and current speed all affect how safely you can take each turn. Push too hard and you may derail, and nobody wants that.

Take on Delivery Missions

Each run begins with delivery missions made up of different tasks. You will be told what cargo you need, how many wagons are required, and where everything needs to go.

Some missions may ask for several wagon types in different quantities, and as you progress, routes become more complex, deliveries spread across multiple locations, and planning becomes just as important as speed.

Cozy Multiplayer

Everything is better together. Team up with 2–4 players and work together to complete missions across miniature railway worlds.

Decide how you want to play: split the wagons between players, coordinate different trains, or create special combinations to tackle each delivery your own way. There’s no competition — just teamwork, coordination, and a little railway chaos along the way.

Hack-and-Slash Roguelite Action in 20–40-Minute Dungeon Runs


Spell Cage is an action roguelite that condenses the combat and buildcrafting of hack-and-slash ARPGs into 20–40-minute runs.

We're developing the full game around unlocking new characters and build components across playthroughs, expanding your options in future runs.

Hands-On, Isometric Hack-and-Slash Combat


Control movement and attack direction independently with WASD and mouse or a gamepad. Cast skills in the direction you choose, even while moving. Managing mana consumption and regeneration is also a key part of skill use and build optimization.

Simple Foundations, Deep Skill Builds


Spell Cage distills the complex build systems of traditional hack-and-slash games into three core pillars: skills, mutators, and passives.

Equip multiple copies of the same skill and raise its tier to amplify its effects, or combine different skills to create synergies. Mutators change the rules of your build, while passives help you balance stat bonuses and penalties.

We're building on this foundation by expanding skill interactions and the range of possible combinations. Our goal is deep buildcrafting where even the same skill loadout can evolve into very different playstyles depending on how these three elements are combined.

Dungeons Focused on Combat


Randomized dungeons have a clear beginning and end, with back-to-back battles against enemy hordes instead of quests or complicated navigation.

Clear a dungeon to reach the shop, sort through your rewards, refine your build, and head into the next dungeon.

About the Current Demo


The current demo lets you experience Spell Cage's core combat and the foundations of its skill-building system.

Build options are still limited. We're continuing to expand skill variety, build diversity, and content depth as we work toward the full release.

We welcome your feedback on combat feel, skill use, and build choices.

Draw 7 letters. Each one is printed on a stock, and the stock is the rule. Spell a word. Deal damage, hang a status, or block what is coming down the street.

Killing a demon only frees the coat. Learn its true name, spell the letters that stick, and banish the thing wearing it. Build a deck out of the alphabet and spell death to a city that stopped reading.

I wrapped the fight in art deco and filled the room with foxtrot, jazz, tango, torch songs and every maqam I could get my hands on. Then I called it a day.

Your Deck Is the Alphabet



There are no cards with abilities. There is only you and your letters. Spell words, awaken spells, print your letters on paper stocks, and bring the pain to the demons who made humanity their illiterate, morally bankrupt slaves. (Y'know, the usual.)

A City That Stopped Reading



Humans lost "The Word", and the demons moved in, shut the presses and stayed. Every run is a new day and the same day: the streets of the Ink Quarter are laid out differently each time. Take the risky road or the safe one, I don't judge. But for your own sake, stop at the Printhouse or the Speakeasy on your way to the bosses of the neighborhood.

Learn Its True Name



Killing a demon only frees the body it wore. It walks off and finds another. Every demon hides a true name. Spell words that share its letters, see which ones stick, then whisper it (or shout it, let it all out) to banish the demon back to wherever it came from.

Paper Decides What a Letter Does



Every letter is printed on a stock, and the stock changes what the letter does. Iron letters make block instead of damage. Most stocks are worth the Ink. A few are Devilish, and they ask for more than that... (A wishlist, a purchase, a like, maybe some ink.)

A love letter to every word game and deckbuilder that came before, a manifesto for what is to come, and hopefully a lesson (good or bad, I don't mind) for those who come after.

What you get when you Spell Death:

  • Four Lettercasters, each with their own way to spell and to deal damage.
  • Four Neighborhoods, from the Ink Quarter down to the Placeless.
  • 136 Lexicon spell effects to find, awaken and carry into a fight.
  • 25 paper stocks that change how your letters behave, for better or for worse.
  • 43 events that can help or harm you. (Developer's note: mostly harm.)
  • Nearly 200,000 legal words.
  • 20 Descension levels. At the top, the bosses stop arriving alone and stop caring what you spell, and you must banish a few fools on the way up.
  • My deep gratitude.

Spell Unbound is a pixel-art roguelite with one spell: a circle you draw with the mouse. Loop a monster and it is bound. There is no other attack.



Keep the loop small and it slows what it holds. Close it round and true and it crits. Take too long and something walks through your line and snaps it, and you will not draw again until your hand recovers.




Put three corners in the stroke and it comes out as fire. A W is lightning. An S lets a snake of ink loose to hunt for you. The circle still catches. You drew both.




Every seventh floor, something waits that will not take an ordinary circle. Bosses lose a piece with every loop - a horn, a crown, an arm, a jaw - until there is nothing left to bind.


The descent is only the first run. Beat it and the Ascent opens: thirty floors up through the ramparts, the cloud sea and the empyrean. Hold three orbs and you can walk the Round, a ring of rooms you cross twice, the second time unravelled.

Off every road there are doors that are not on the map - a vault behind a dial, a ring of mushrooms, a lantern-lit void, something in a pit under the Hollow that counts the souls you bind.




The descent is a branching map, walked one room at a time: a pack, an elite and its escort, a treasure and its guards, a gauntlet of traps, or Quillgut, who deals sigils out of a dead scribe's ledger. Some rooms hold a cage. Loop it, and whoever was inside comes home with you to the Megalith, the last refuge left after the Great Flame, and starts trading for what you carry back. The beasts you beat can live in the garden.




Scribes unlock as you go, and each one breaks a rule: a line that cannot be severed, a line that never retracts, one with no line at all.

Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a chaotic arena brawler where rival mages blast each other with powerful spells as the arena crumbles beneath their feet. Draft new abilities and items each round to create your build, then use it to outplay your opponents across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Land skill shots, evade incoming spells, knock rivals into the void, and survive the chaos.

ZERO CLASSES, TOTAL CHAOS

Words are weapons

Draw a random hand of letters. Piece together a word. Hurl it at an enemy. Spellk is a turn-based word-combat roguelite you can play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

Take your time choosing a word. Enemies that survive your attack strike back.

Nearly four years after the beloved original launched as a free web game, Spellk returns on Steam as a ground-up remaster—greatly expanded with new items, enemies, mechanics, companions, an unfolding story, and online co-op.

Change what makes a good word

Find the Catchphrase Carrot, choose a word—even one you made up—and spell it for +150% damage. “FLORB” just became a tactical decision.

Grapes of Grandiloquence make long words hit harder. Combine extra word slots with a Wordsteel Dagger to earn bonus damage from consecutive words that share a letter: BLAZE, then HEAL, in a single attack.

Boost particular letters, remove unwanted ones, and make your favorites appear more often. With a different build, the same handful of letters can send you hunting for a completely different word.

A huge vocabulary helps. A clever build can matter just as much.

Four hands. One attack.

Everyone gets their own letter hand, items, and potions. Compare your options, lock in your words, and unleash your attacks together once the whole party is ready.

More players mean tougher enemies—and more ways to help each other hit harder.

Keep the build alive

Fight through regions, defeat their bosses, and choose rewards that shape your next fight. Use potions to add the missing letter, redraw an awkward hand, or restore your party’s health.

Finish the campaign, then carry your build into Endless and see how far it holds up. Every new run starts a fresh build.

Pets with something to say

Unlock pets with their own ideas about combat. A rat helps you spot useful words you might have missed. A parrot repeats past spells for bonus damage. A snake stretches the S’s in your words to make them hurt more.

The calico cat contributes by meowing at your enemies. Unlock its longer outburst for a considerably louder opinion.

The pets you’ve unlocked are yours to keep between runs.

Make every letter hurt.
